affected_region.isometric: Detected objects are represented by isolated boxes without any underlying dense point cluster or structural point-cloud support.

evidence: The bounding boxes in the BEV view correspond to empty regions with no discernible dense cluster of points that would indicate an object surface.
The isometric view confirms the absence of 3D structural integrity: the bounding boxes appear empty and lack any point-cloud support below or within them.
The point cloud data in these regions shows no vertical extent or geometric features consistent with a pedestrian; they appear to be purely synthetic detections.
alternatives_ruled_out: Natural sensor noise or occlusion (the boxes are too distinct and structurally empty).
Distant real objects (there is no geometric or intensity signature of a pedestrian at those coordinates).
Calibration error (the rest of the scene aligns correctly).
